method: Delivered Vesper GLB sha256 60f43cba493253a6f391e0668bde58c763e8c0fd825d825465d318fc1612e902 in the hero-select preview and in game; production WardenWeapon fit (tsuka + thin fuchi, seat from KatanaGrip.mjs); the fist and the fitted hilt triangles measured in the weapon frame. Skin clearance = vertex-to-triangle distance over every fully hand-weighted skin vertex within 6 cm of the hilt axis.
rootCause: The tsuka band fitted by fitShaft ramped back to the native 3.8 cm collar over 6 cm in front of the fist, and the seat (0.29 m) left the index side 6.9 cm behind the tsuba: 6.5 cm of collar and handle showed between the fist and the guard.
fix: The katana's fitted tsuka now keeps its slender radius up to a fuchi of KATANA_GRIP.fuchi.length (8 mm, radius 1.35x the tsuka) right behind the tsuba; the seat moved to 0.356 m so the fist's index side ends 3.0 mm behind the tsuba back face; the hand fit keeps 1.5 mm over the measured hilt radius per 2 mm slice (fuchi included). All 22 Vesper clips re-authored with the new seat; every authoring gate passes.
